# Nanoparticle_Network_Reservoir

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A neuromorphic computing substrate where interconnected nanoparticles form a physical reservoir that maps input signals to high-dimensional states for computation. Enables low-power, hardware-based reservoir computing without traditional transistor architectures, advancing in-network neuromorphic processing.
